text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower achieved splendid results 
in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through those truly 
precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, on a day spent basking in the 
afterglow of that major milestone—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
“—We will now announce the winner! This 
year's 'Best Sprinter' is... Nishino 
Flower!”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations! And what's more, for 
Nishino Flower's Trainer, who continued to 
support her through it all...

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
We hereby present the specially 
established 'Outstanding Rookie Trainer 
Award'! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower's performance had been 
nothing short of spectacular. Naturally, I 
believed she deserved an award, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To think I'd be receiving an award too...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... Congratulations, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Now, please tell us how it feels to 
receive this award!
choice_data_list: Um, thank you for having me—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Once again, congratulations, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...After the Sprinters Stakes, Zephyr told 
me that 'the future is coming,' but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So this is what you meant, isn't it?♪ I'm 
so happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet the future that arrived... was not 
merely that alone."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, I look forward to working 
with you today as well!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to begin training with 
Nishino Flower as usual...

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me! May we train together with 
you?

text_block_list.name: Freshman A
text_block_list.text: "We want you to scout us, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Freshman B
text_block_list.text:
"I was watching your race the whole time, 
Flower-san. You were incredibly cool...!"

text_block_list.name: Freshman B
text_block_list.text:
I thought that a Trainer who raised such 
an incredible Umamusume... was someone I 
wanted to entrust my future to as well.

text_block_list.name: Freshman C
text_block_list.text:
Same for me... I'd like to receive your 
guidance, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Freshmen
text_block_list.text: Please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want your guidance"— Three years ago, I 
never could have imagined so many girls 
stepping forward to ask for that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yet all of this was thanks to Nishino 
Flower's hard work. Putting her first 
should be my priority... Just as I was 
thinking of talking to her later—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please check on everyone else 
first!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'll be fine going after that! ...I'll be 
watching over you from the stands♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you want to put yourself 
last?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sky-san!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... did you see that exchange 
just now?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I saw you, Trainer-san. You've gotten 
super popular, huh?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...I'm so, so happy.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I've always been praying that your future 
opens up even wider, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So when I see you being looked up to like 
that, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, it just makes me smile.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Flower, don't you ever get 
jealous?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Grill...? Um, I'll make sure to cook 
everything thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry, never mind. I guess that 
concept just doesn't exist for you.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, as long as you didn't draw it 
reluctantly, then all's well that ends 
well.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Sky, were you checking on me out of 
concern?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Well, well~ Now then~. ...Actually, 
there's something I wanted to tell you, 
Flower."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
About that flowerbed... ...If you're going 
to show her, wouldn't today be the day?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer! Over here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the orientation for the 
new students, and wrapping up Nishino 
Flower's training, she led me to...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm the one who looks after this 
flower bed, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I planted flower seedlings as a memento of 
my races. I was growing them so I could 
show you someday, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Compared to three years ago, so many more 
flowers have bloomed!
choice_data_list:
You've been making this for me since three 
years ago!?

You've been making this for me for three 
years!?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A variety of colorful flowers sway in the 
breeze. Red, pink, yellow, orange, 
white... Each one represents everything 
we've been through...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"I've wanted to show you for so long, but 
I just didn't know when the right time 
was."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because today is the day everyone realized 
what a splendid Trainer you are...♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Working hard together with you, Trainer, 
has made this many flowers bloom.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
If my Trainer smiles... that makes me 
happier than anything else!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Let us make many more flowers bloom from 
here on. Together, we can...!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes! Both of them are fully fledged now♪

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Now, go take a look at the flowers! If 
there's anything you don't understand, 
just ask me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's a daisy... a daisy flower!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
It was quite difficult to grow things in 
this flower bed, but... they bloomed so 
beautifully♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A peaceful, tender time goes by. I want to 
continue watching over her growth from 
here on out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until the day it blooms into a magnificent 
flower—
